description: Defines the API and data structures for CoAP service integration in Zephyr OS, including resource and service management functions, configuration flags, and related macros.

methods.name: coap_service_start
methods.description: Starts the specified CoAP service, returning success or error code.

methods.name: coap_service_stop
methods.description: Stops the specified CoAP service, returning success or error code.

methods.name: coap_service_is_running
methods.description: Checks if the specified CoAP service is currently running.

methods.name: coap_service_send
methods.description: Sends a CoAP message from the specified service.

methods.name: coap_resource_send
methods.description: Sends a CoAP message from the specified resource.

methods.name: coap_resource_parse_observe
methods.description: Parses an observe request for a resource, returning observe option value.

methods.name: coap_resource_remove_observer_by_addr
methods.description: Removes an observer from a resource by address.

methods.name: coap_resource_remove_observer_by_token
methods.description: Removes an observer from a resource by token.
